doc.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Diva's international members
summary: Diva includes players from Austria, Israel, Australia, Japan and Italy, including Karolina Strassmayer, Anat Cohen and the Parrott sisters.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Yeah, Anat. An interesting thing, since you mentioned Anat is also what I’m finding really fascinating is well I’m the only American in my quintet first of all. But the women in Diva are literally women from all over the world. That’s really fascinating also, how our alto player, Karolina Strassmayer comes from Bad Mitterndorf, Austria, this little tiny village. Her dad is like a forest ranger. You know how the heck did she come out playing — like an unbelievable jazz player. She a genius, a brilliant jazz player. And just like the impact of music, and Anat from Israel and Nicki and our bass player Nicki’s sister Lisa, they’re from Australia. Nicki plays bari sax [error, Nicki plays bass and Lisa plays bari sax] in our big band, and we have rhythm section players, two players from Japan and we have a girl from Italy playing tenor sax with us. People, just women from all over but I think that’s pretty amazing.

That’s interesting. If this was an all-guy band and you had those same nationalities they would probably promote it as an international type band. But you’ve got two kinds of interesting identities to your band. It’s great.
